official_definition: Twinkle Body Substitution - When this Spirit becomes the target of an opposing effect, you can summon a pre-advent card underneath this Spirit, without paying the cost. Then, change the target of that effect to that Spirit only.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Twinkle Body Substitution] or [Twinkle Body Substitution: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Twinkle Body Substitution]", "give [Twinkle Body Substitution]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
